messages:
alyssa: Heads-up — Elm cohort has 28 seats but only 18 have completed the onboarding survey. Need to finalize the A/B onboarding split and schedule enablement calls this week. Can someone help triage?
sam: I can take the scheduling, alyssa. Do we have the A/B assignment list yet?
alyssa: Not fully. Priya started the split but didn’t finish mapping to seat IDs. Spreadsheet here: https://tiny.redwood/elm-beta-assign (view-only for now).
priya: sorry, falling behind. I added a column `onboard_flow` with values A or B. Quick sample: `user_012 -> A`, `user_019 -> B`. I’ll finish by EOD.
devon: For feedback alignment — are we running different post-call surveys or just onboarding content variants?
alyssa: Variant A = self-serve guided prompts + short intro call (20m). Variant B = live walkthrough (35m) + task checklist. Post-call survey differs slightly (A has 4 questions, B has 6).
sam: OK. I’ll open calendar blocks for both types. Can you confirm timezones? Elm team is mostly PST with one EU contact.
priya: PST works. For the EU contact we’ll do a late slot on Wed.
onboard-bot: Reminder: publish survey links after welcome email. Command: `/publish-survey elm-beta A https://survey.redwood/s/elmA`
alyssa: @sam please wait 1 hour before sending calendar invites — want to update invites with the final flow assignment (will import when I finish mapping).
sam: ack. I’ll hold invites.
priya: mapping done. Pasted CSV into the sheet and added `survey_link` column. Example row: `user_019, B, https://survey.redwood/s/elmB`.
devon: Great. I’ll create a small analysis doc to compare NPS and task success across A/B. Will tag the repo: `docs/elm-beta/ab-analysis.md`
alyssa: Perfect. Two small asks before invites go out: 1) Confirm we have enablement runbook for flow B (longer call). 2) Confirm export of survey responses into the internal analytics workspace.
priya: Runbook ✅ — linked in sheet notes.
onboard-bot: Export task queued: `export-survey elm-beta to analytics:started`
sam: Ok, I’ll send invites at 18:10 PST.
devon: Ping me when responses start coming in, I’ll bootstrap the dashboard.
alyssa: Thanks all — will post a quick recap once invites are sent. :thumbsup:
